title: The two-term cohomological delta-functor
statement: Let G be a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected topological group, A a finite ring, and tau in G. Give the discrete continuous representation category C its abelian structure [lem-exc-discrete-modules-abelian]. The functors H^q(K(-)), for K the explicit action complex [def-exc-action-two-term-complex], carry the structure of a cohomological delta-functor [def-weil-pbc-delta-functor], with equality of its degree-q functor to K followed by homology in every q.

source.place: First paragraph, short exact complexes and the cohomological delta-functor

proof.text: Use the finite-limit and finite-colimit preserving underlying-module functor of discreteModules_abelian. It is additive and preserves short exact sequences. The explicit coefficient-map formula makes K additive too. Evaluation of K on a short exact sequence is that underlying sequence in degrees 0 and 1 and a zero sequence in all higher degrees. Hence K preserves short exact sequences.

Mathlib HomologicalComplex.HomologySequence supplies the connecting maps and the three exactness positions. Its δ_naturality supplies naturality in a short-exact-sequence morphism. The map on degree-zero homology is monic by mono_homologyMap_of_mono_of_not_rel since no differential enters zero. Package these fields into CohomologicalDeltaFunctor.
